Class ServerController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.control.ServerController
public class ServerController extends Object
Core server-side controller for the client-server architecture of the game. This class is responsible for managing all connected clients and handling the events they generate during the game. Events are processed using the visitor pattern. Responsibilities include: - Managing the list of connected clients - Processing and dispatching events from clients using ClientHandlerVisitor - Synchronizing access to shared game state on a per-client basis - Creating and coordinating the GameController to control game logic - Loading saved games and handling resume functionality when available - Monitoring client activity through a periodic heartbeat check - Broadcasting server-side events to all clients when needed Events are queued and processed concurrently using a fixed thread pool. For each event, the visitor determines the appropriate logic, updates the model, and returns a ServerEvent to notify one or more clients of the result.

    • startDispatcher

      public void startDispatcher()
      Starts the dispatcher thread responsible for processing events from the socket-based clients. It continuously waits for events from the event queue and delegates them for processing using a worker thread from the thread pool.

    • processEvent

      public void processEvent(EventWithSource eventWithSource, ClientHandlerVisitor visitor)
      Processes a single client event in a thread-safe manner. Each client is associated with a lock to ensure their events are handled one at a time and in the order they were received. This guarantees consistency in the game state and in how responses are delivered to the client.
      Parameters:
      eventWithSource - the event along with the client who sent it
      visitor - the visitor used to handle the event

    • handleEventLogic

      private void handleEventLogic(EventWithSource source, ClientHandlerVisitor visitor)
      Executes the actual logic for a client event using the visitor. If this is the first valid event and the game hasn't been created yet, it initializes the GameController using the settings provided by the visitor. The resulting ServerEvent is either sent to all clients or only to the source client, depending on the event's properties.
      Parameters:
      source - the client event and its originating client
      visitor - the visitor responsible for handling the event logic

    • broadcastEvent

      public void broadcastEvent(ServerEvent e)
      Sends a server event to all connected clients.
      Parameters:
      e - the event to broadcast

    • startThreadHourglass

      public void startThreadHourglass()
      Starts the hourglass timer for the building phase. If the hourglass is ended and there are still players that haven't ended their building phase this method initializes their positions, ensuring they are placed in valid locations. It also calls wellDone() methods on each spaceship depending on the game level, then broadcasts a BuildCompleteEvent to all clients.

    • startHeartbeat

      private void startHeartbeat()
      Starts a scheduled heartbeat task to monitor client activity. Every few seconds, it checks whether each client has timed out. Timed-out clients are disconnected and removed from the game. If any client is removed, the game is ended and scores are computed.

    • finishGame

      public void finishGame(ArrayList<Client> toRemove)
      Finalizes the game if any client was removed due to timeout or disconnection. Computes the final scores of all players and sends an EndGameEvent to all clients.
      Parameters:
      toRemove - the list of clients to be removed from the game
